name: Permanent Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 consecutive years of legal residence in Albania before eligibility for permanent residence status.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 consecutive years of legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Beyond the 5-year residence period, applicants must demonstrate 'stable activities or relationships in the country' -- the precise definition of this standard was not confirmed at tier-1 precision.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous legal residence
Evidence of stable activity/relationships in Albania

sources.title: EURAXESS Albania -- Residence Permits and Accommodation: 5 consecutive years' legal residence plus 'stable activities or relationships' for permanent residence status

Karanovic & Partners -- Albania Adopts Amendments to the Law on Foreigners: confirms 5-year continuous legal residence threshold for permanent residence, under Law No. 108/2013 on Foreigners as amended

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). STATUS: DRAFT -- despite the underlying legal basis being a real, named statute (Law No. 108/2013 'Për të Huajt' / Law on Foreigners, as amended), no .gov.al or Official Gazette (QBZ) page hosting the primary text or a government-authored summary of the 5-year permanent-residence threshold was found and fetched during this research pass; both citing sources are tier 3 (a law firm and the EU's EURAXESS researcher-mobility network, not an Albanian government domain). The two sources independently agree on the 5-year figure, which increases confidence, but per this dataset's sourcing convention a published-status route needs a tier-1 citation for its hard requirements, so this file stays draft until a primary or government-hosted source is located. citizenship_after_months (24) reflects the gap between reaching permanent residence and the earliest point the 7-year Article 8(1) naturalization clock plausibly closes, itself an approximation -- see al_naturalisation.json.
